lines.1: 「Finished. That took less time than I expected.」
lines.2: 「You really made the place your own in no time.」
lines.4: 「I cannot sleep on a different pillow. I brought my own pillow and futon.」
lines.5: 「This may be your house, but knock before entering this room.」
lines.6: She mimed knocking as she reminded me of something that should have been obvious.
lines.8: 「Oh, you don't need to worry about that.」
